readout.summary: Every pick is Chicago (7-2, off a bye) to win. The reasons: an improved Bears defense against a Saints line missing three starters, and Caleb Williams bouncing back from a four-interception game. The spread leans New Orleans +11.5: SI, CBS's simulation model and 4 of 7 CBS experts take it, pointing to the Saints' close losses and eight straight road covers.
readout.pick: Bears straight up (unanimous: CBS Prisco and Breech, NFL.com 5-0, ESPN panel, Dimers model); ATS: Saints +11.5 (SI/DraftKings, CBS SportsLine model; CBS: Prisco, Dubin, Wilson, Sullivan) vs Bears -11.5 (CBS: Breech, Richard, Eisenberg)
readout.predicted_score: Bears 24-16 (CBS, Pete Prisco, Nov 19); Bears 31-20 (CBS, John Breech, Nov 17); Bears 42-17 (NFL.com, Gennaro Filice); NFL.com panel: 40-17, 42-24, 42-17, 38-24, 30-17; ESPN: Bears 27-20 (Maldonado), 30-17 (Moody), 34-20 (Walder); Bears 28-17 (Dimers model; its widget shows 29-18)
readout.moneyline: DraftKings Bears -700 / Saints +500 (SI, Nov 17 2026); Bears -770 / Saints +540 (NFL.com, lines as of Nov 19, book not named); spread CHI -11.5 (opened -9.5 per CBS), total 48.5
readout.win_probability: ESPN FPI: Bears 78.5%, average margin 7.9 points (ESPN Week 11 guide, Nov 20 2026); Dimers model: Bears 82.7%
readout.injuries: Final reports Fri Nov 20 2026. Saints: Out C Erik McCoy (biceps), T Taliese Fuaga (knee), T Asim Richards (knee), CB Martin Emerson Jr. (concussion), S Justin Reid (personal matter); Questionable CB Decamerion Richardson (thigh), LB Pete Werner (hamstring); WR Jordyn Tyson (chest) and RB CJ Donaldson (shoulder) no designation; RB Alvin Kamara rest day. Bears: Out CB Kyler Gordon (shoulder); Questionable WR Zavion Thomas (ankle); no designation for DT Jeffery Simmons (knee), WR Luther Burden III (concussion), RB Kyle Monangai (toe; expected back for the first time since Week 4), CB Malik Muhammad (toe).
